subject: [RFC PATCH v3 10/14] mm/memcontrol: Make memory.max tier-aware

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch makes the memory.max limit in Linux's memory cgroup controller tier-aware, allowing it to enforce fair distribution of memory among workloads isolated by the controller. The existing limit is extended to consider the page counter of the tier where a folio was allocated, and reclaim is targeted at that tier's nodes when its counter exceeds the limit. This patch also updates the mem_cgroup_margin function to take into account the tier slot, ensuring that the retry check and OOM re-check under oom_lock consider the tier that actually failed.
